question_text:
Of the last 30 students, 25 passed the test. What is the experimental probability that the next will have the same result?
Write your answer as a fraction or whole number.
P(event)=_
solution: Remember, the experimental probability is the number of times an event occurs out of the total number of trials.
Write the experimental probability as a fraction in simplest form.
P(event) = $\frac{\text{favorable}}{\text{total}}$ = $\frac{25}{30}$=$\frac{5}{6}$
So, P(event) = $\frac{5}{6}$
